verses.sanskrit:
ब्राहाण उवाच।
              अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। कार्तवीर्यस्य संवादं समुद्रस्य च भाविनि॥१॥
verses.english: The Brahmana said About it is cited the ancient story O lady, of the discourse between Kartavirya and the Ocean.

verses.sanskrit: कार्तवीर्यार्जुनो नाम राजा बाहुसहस्रवान्। येन सागरपर्यन्ता धनुषा निर्जिता मही॥२॥
verses.english: There was a king named Kartavirya-Arjuna who had a thousand arms. He conquered, with his bow, the Earth extending to the ocean.

verses.sanskrit: स कदाचित्समुद्रान्ते विचरन्बलदर्पितः। अवाकिरन् शरशतैः समुद्रमिति नः श्रुतम्॥३॥
verses.english: We have heard that, once on a time, as he was walking on the shores of the sea, proud of his power, he showered hundreds of arrows on thal vast receptacle of water.

verses.sanskrit: तं समुद्रो नमस्कृत्य कृताञ्जलिरुवाच ह। मा मुञ्च वीर नाराचान् ब्रूहि किं करवाणि ते॥४॥
verses.english: The Ocean, bowing down to him, said, with joined hands, Do not, O hero. discharged your arrows (at me)! Say, what shall I do to you.

verses.sanskrit: मदाश्रयाणि भूतानि त्वद्विसृष्टैर्महेषुभिः। वध्यन्ते राजशार्दूल तेभ्यो देह्यभयं विभो॥५॥
verses.english: With these strong arrows shot by you, those creatures which have taken shelter in me are being killed, O foremost of kings! Do you, O lord, grant them security.

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच।
              मत्समो यदि सङ्ग्रामे शरासनधरः क्वचित्। विद्यते तं समाचक्ष्व यः समासीत मां मृधे॥६॥
verses.english: If any holder of the bow exists that is equal to me in battle, and that would stand against mc in the field, do you name him to me.

verses.sanskrit:
समुद्र उवाच।
              महर्षिर्जमदग्निस्ते यदि राजन्परिश्रुतः। तस्य पुत्रस्तवातिथ्यं यथावत् कर्तुमर्हति॥७॥
verses.english: The Ocean said If you have heard, O king, of the great Rishi Jamadagni, his son is competent to duly receive you as a guest.

verses.sanskrit: ततः स राजा प्रययौ क्रोधेन महता वृतः। स तमाश्रममागम्य राममेवान्वपद्यत॥८॥
verses.english: Then that king proceeded, becoming highly irate. Arrived at that hermitage, he found Rama himself.

verses.sanskrit: स रामप्रतिकूलानि चकार सह बन्धुभिः। आयासं जनयामास रामस्य च महात्मनः॥९॥
verses.english: With his kinsmen he began to do many deeds while were hostile to Rama, and caused much trouble to that grcat hero.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तेजः प्रजज्वाल रामस्यामिततेजसः। प्रदहन् रिपुसैन्यानि तदा कमललोचने॥१०॥
verses.english: Then the energy, which was immeasurable, of Rama shone forth, burning the troops of the enemy, O lotus-eyed one.

verses.sanskrit: ततः परशुमादाय स तं बाहुसहस्रिणम्। चिच्छेद सहसा रामो बहुशाखमिव द्रुमम्॥११॥
तं हतं पतितं दृष्ट्वा समेताः सर्वबान्धवाः। असीनादाय शक्तीश्च भार्गवं पर्यधावयन्॥१२॥
verses.english: Seeing him killed and laid low on the earth, all his kinsmen, collected in a body, and taking up their darts rushed at Rama, who was then scated, from all sides.

verses.sanskrit: रामोऽपि धनुरादाय रथमारुह्य सत्वरः। विसृजन् शरवर्षाणि व्यधमत्पार्थिवं बलम्॥१३॥
ततस्तु क्षत्रियाः केचिज्जामदग्न्यभयार्दिताः। विविशुर्गिरिदुर्गाणि मृगाः सिंहार्दिता इव॥१४॥
verses.english: Then, some of the Kshatriyas, stricken with the terror of Jamadagni's son, entered mountain fastnesses, like deer afflicted by the lion.

verses.sanskrit: तेषां स्वविहितं कर्म तद्भयान्नानुतिष्ठताम्। प्रजा वृषलता प्राप्ता ब्राह्मणानामदर्शनात्॥१५॥
verses.english: Of them that were unable, through feat of Rama, lo perform the duties ordained for their order, the progeny became Vrishalas owing to their inability to find Brahmanas.

verses.sanskrit: एवं ते द्रविडाऽऽभीरा: पुण्ड्राश्च शबरैः सह। वृषलत्वं परिगता व्युत्थानात् क्षत्रधर्मिणः॥१६॥
verses.english: Thus the Dravidas and Adhiras and Pundars together with the Shavaras, became Vrishalas through those men who had Kshatriya duties assigned to them, following away (from them).

verses.sanskrit: ततश्च हतवीरासु क्षत्रियासु पुनः पुनः। द्विजैरुत्पादितं क्षत्रं जामदग्न्यो न्यकृन्तत॥१७॥
verses.english: Then the Kshatriyas that were begotten by the Brahmanas upon Kshatriya women who had lost their heroic children, were repeatedly destroyed by Jamadagni's son.

verses.sanskrit: एकविंशतिमेधान्ते रामं वागशरीरिणी। दिव्या प्रोवाच मधुरा सर्वलोकपरिश्रुता॥१८॥
verses.english: The destruction proceeded one and twenty times. At its conclusion a bodiless voice, sweet and coming from the celestial region, and which was heard by all people, spoke to Rama, O Rama, O Rama, stop! What merit do you see, O son, in thus destroying repeatedly these inferior Kshatriyas?

verses.sanskrit: राम राम निवर्तस्व कं गुणं तात पश्यसि। क्षत्रबधूनिमान् प्राणैर्विप्रयोज्य पुनः पुनः॥१९॥
verses.bhavadeepa: एकविंशतितमेधान्ते मेधो युद्धयज्ञः। "यज्ञो वै मेध" इति श्रुतेः। यान्येव सङ्ग्रामनामानि तानि यज्ञानामानीति नैरुक्तवचनात् युद्धस्यैव नाम मेध इति॥१८॥

verses.sanskrit: तथैव तं महात्मानमृचीकप्रमुखास्तदा। पितामहा महाभाग निवर्तस्वेत्यथाब्रुवन्॥२०॥
verses.english: Thus, O blessed dame, his grandsires, headed by Richika, addressed that great one, saying, Do you, desist.

verses.sanskrit: पितुर्वधममृष्यंस्तु रामः प्रोवाच तानृषीन्। नार्हन्तीह भवन्तो मां निवारयितुमित्युत॥२१॥
verses.english: Rama, however, unable to forgive the destruction of his father, replied to those Rishis, saying, you should not forbid me.

verses.sanskrit:
पितर ऊचुः।
              नार्हसे क्षत्रबन्धूंस्त्वं निहन्तुं जयतां वर। नेह युक्तं त्वया हन्तुं ब्राह्मणेन सता नृपान्॥२२॥
